info.name: 404 Coffee Backend API
info.description:
Full API collection for 404 Coffee Backend

## Setup
1. Start Backend: `npm run dev` (port 3000)
2. Login from Auth → Login (Admin)
3. JWT is auto-saved to `{{accessToken}}` variable
4. All other endpoints will work automatically

## Variables
- `baseUrl` — Backend URL (default: http://localhost:3000)
- `accessToken` — Admin JWT (auto-set by Login)
- `refreshToken` — Refresh token (auto-set by Login)
- `tableToken` — Table session token (auto-set by session open)
- `trackingToken` — Order tracking token
- `employeeId` — Set after creating/getting a user
- `deviceId` — Set after listing devices
